objective: Produce a fully auditable attrition accounting from venue discovery through semantic cleaning, within-venue canonicalization, Kalshi history availability, multi-venue census, exact/candidate dedup and official truth. Do not relabel census-only venues as backtestable.

unit_policy.rule: Every row must state its unit explicitly. Counts with different units may not be used as parent/child retention denominators.
unit_policy.double_counting: Raw family capacity upper bounds that may count the same event under multiple families are contextual diagnostics only and never an attrition denominator.

KALSHI_SEMANTIC.bridge_note: K1->K2 is alias/strike canonicalization; retention is reported but unit changes must be explicitly labeled.

KALSHI_HISTORY.definition: T-240h and T-1h valid and >=8/10 horizons
>=50% market validity at T-240h and T-1h plus >=8/10 event horizons; descriptive only
all audited events not satisfying CORE_T10_TO_T1H, broken out by NO_T10D, NO_NEAR_T0, PARTIAL and NO_HISTORY reason

CROSS_VENUE.bridge_note: Exact identical W4CE1 aliases collapse here.

family_breakdown.rule: For every stage whose records carry resolved_family, materialize N by family in addition to total N. Family totals must reconcile to stage total unless the stage is explicitly cross-family/unresolved.
family_breakdown.retention: Where parent and child share the same unit and family semantics, report child_N / parent_N. Otherwise retention_pct must be blank and a unit_transition_note required.

exclusion_reasons.conservation: At each same-unit attrition transition, parent_N = child_N + mutually exclusive excluded_N. If exclusions overlap, provide separate non-additive diagnostic columns and do not claim conservation.

claim_limits.w4b_truth_verified_union: May be reported as the official-truth-verified multi-venue event universe.
claim_limits.kalshi_history_qualified: May be reported separately using frozen FULL_LADDER/CORE history definitions, subject to later official-time revalidation.
claim_limits.reason: W4-B as ordered audits full T-10d->T0 history for Kalshi before adding ForecastEx/Polymarket census. ForecastEx and Polymarket require their own subsequent PIT-history qualification before their events may enter N_final_backtestable.
